"""Shared helpers for API routes: curve resolution, position conversion, market context."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from app.api.schemas import CurveSpec, PolicyParams, PositionIn
from app.core.curve import ParCurve, curve_shape
from app.core.daycount import DayCount
from app.core.policy import INTERPRETATIONS, TRANSMISSION_PROFILES, translate_policy_scenario
from app.core.portfolio import Position
from app.core.schedule import treasury_settlement
from app.data.store import MarketDataStore


def to_positions(items: list[PositionIn]) -> list[Position]:
    ids = [p.id for p in items]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        raise ValueError("position ids must be unique")
    return [
        Position(
            id=p.id, label=p.label, coupon_rate=p.coupon_pct / 100.0, maturity=p.maturity,
            face_amount=p.face_amount, frequency=p.frequency, day_count=DayCount(p.day_count),
        )
        for p in items
    ]


def resolve_curve(store: MarketDataStore, spec: CurveSpec) -> tuple[ParCurve, date, dict]:
    """Return (par curve, as-of date, provenance). Custom curves are labeled as user input."""
    if spec.custom_par_pct:
        as_of = spec.date or store.resolve_curve_date(None)
        par = ParCurve.from_percent(dict(spec.custom_par_pct), as_of=as_of.isoformat())
        prov = {"source": "User-supplied par curve", "mode": "user", "url": None,
                "retrieved_at_utc": None, "last_observation": None,
                "note": "Hypothetical curve entered by the user - not market data."}
        return par, as_of, prov
    par, d = store.curve_on(spec.date)
    return par, d, store.curve_provenance.to_dict()


def settlement_for(curve_date: date, override: date | None) -> date:
    return override or treasury_settlement(curve_date)


def market_context(store: MarketDataStore, par: ParCurve, as_of: date, prov: dict) -> dict:
    pct = par.to_percent()
    shape = curve_shape(pct)
    pr = store.policy_range_on(as_of)
    sources = [
        f"U.S. Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve Rates, observation {as_of.isoformat()} ({prov.get('mode')}).",
        f"FRED DFEDTARL/DFEDTARU target range as of {pr['as_of']}.",
    ]
    return {
        "curve_as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "curve_mode": prov.get("mode"),
        "policy_lower": pr["lower"], "policy_upper": pr["upper"], "policy_as_of": pr["as_of"],
        "policy_range": pr,
        "y2": pct.get("2Y", float("nan")), "y10": pct.get("10Y", float("nan")),
        "s2s10": shape["spread_2s10s_bp"] or 0.0, "s3m10": shape["spread_3m10y_bp"] or 0.0,
        "shape": shape["shape"],
        "sources": sources,
    }


def policy_translation(p: PolicyParams) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    if p.interpretation not in INTERPRETATIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown interpretation {p.interpretation!r}")
    if p.transmission not in TRANSMISSION_PROFILES:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown transmission profile {p.transmission!r}")
    preset = INTERPRETATIONS[p.interpretation]
    beta = dict(TRANSMISSION_PROFILES[p.transmission]["beta"])
    if p.pass_through:
        beta.update(p.pass_through)
    params = {
        "priced_in": preset["priced_in"] if p.priced_in is None else p.priced_in,
        "path_bp": preset["path_bp"] if p.path_bp is None else p.path_bp,
        "term_premium_bp": preset["term_premium_bp"] if p.term_premium_bp is None else p.term_premium_bp,
    }
    tr = translate_policy_scenario(
        p.policy_move_bp, params["priced_in"], params["path_bp"], params["term_premium_bp"], beta,
        p.overlay_kind, p.overlay_bp, p.overlay_pivot,
    )
    assumptions = [
        f"Market interpretation: {preset['label']} - {preset['note']}",
        f"Share of move priced in: {params['priced_in']*100:.0f}%; expected-path revision {params['path_bp']:+.0f} bp; "
        f"term-premium shift {params['term_premium_bp']:+.0f} bp.",
        f"Transmission profile: {TRANSMISSION_PROFILES[p.transmission]['label']}"
        + (" (with user overrides)" if p.pass_through else "") + ".",
        f"Curve overlay: {p.overlay_kind}" + (f" {p.overlay_bp:+.0f} bp" if p.overlay_kind != "none" else "") + ".",
        tr["formula"],
    ]
    return tr, {"params": params, "assumptions": assumptions, "beta": beta}

"""Pydantic request schemas. Units are explicit in every field name:
*_pct  = percent (4.25 means 4.25%), *_bp = basis points (1bp = 0.01%)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date as Date
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, model_validator

from app.data.sources import TENORS

DayCountName = Literal["ACT/ACT-ICMA", "30/360", "ACT/360", "ACT/365F"]
Tenor = Literal["1M", "3M", "6M", "1Y", "2Y", "3Y", "5Y", "7Y", "10Y", "20Y", "30Y"]


class PositionIn(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    label: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    coupon_pct: float = Field(ge=0, le=25, description="Annual coupon rate in percent")
    maturity: Date
    face_amount: float = Field(gt=0, le=1e11, description="Face amount in USD")
    frequency: Literal[1, 2, 4, 12] = 2
    day_count: DayCountName = "ACT/ACT-ICMA"


class CurveSpec(BaseModel):
    date: Date | None = Field(None, description="Use the Treasury curve on/before this date; latest if omitted")
    custom_par_pct: dict[Tenor, float] | None = Field(
        None, description="Override with a user-supplied par curve (percent by tenor)"
    )

    @field_validator("custom_par_pct")
    @classmethod
    def _range(cls, v):
        if v is not None:
            if len(v) < 2:
                raise ValueError("custom curve needs at least two tenors")
            for t, y in v.items():
                if not -5 <= y <= 30:
                    raise ValueError(f"{t}: yield {y}% outside [-5%, 30%]")
        return v


class PortfolioRequest(BaseModel):
    positions: list[PositionIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()
    settlement: Date | None = None


class ScenarioRequest(PortfolioRequest):
    shocks_bp: dict[Tenor, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @field_validator("shocks_bp")
    @classmethod
    def _bounds(cls, v):
        for t, s in v.items():
            if abs(s) > 1000:
                raise ValueError(f"{t}: shock {s}bp exceeds +/-1000bp")
        return v


class CompareRequest(BaseModel):
    a: list[PositionIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    b: list[PositionIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    name_a: str = "Portfolio A"
    name_b: str = "Portfolio B"
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()
    shocks_bp: dict[Tenor, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ShapeRequest(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["parallel", "preset", "anchors", "custom"]
    bp: float = 0.0
    preset: str | None = None
    scale: float = 1.0
    anchors: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None
    custom: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None


class BondRequest(BaseModel):
    maturity: Date
    coupon_pct: float = Field(ge=0, le=25)
    frequency: Literal[1, 2, 4, 12] = 2
    day_count: DayCountName = "ACT/ACT-ICMA"
    settlement: Date
    mode: Literal["yield", "price", "curve"] = "yield"
    ytm_pct: float | None = Field(None, ge=-5, le=50)
    clean_price: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=1000)
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()
    face_amount: float = Field(1_000_000, gt=0)
    shocks_bp: list[float] = Field(default_factory=lambda: [-300, -200, -100, -50, -25, 25, 50, 100, 200, 300])

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _need_input(self):
        if self.maturity <= self.settlement:
            raise ValueError("maturity must be after settlement")
        if self.mode == "yield" and self.ytm_pct is None:
            raise ValueError("ytm_pct required when mode='yield'")
        if self.mode == "price" and self.clean_price is None:
            raise ValueError("clean_price required when mode='price'")
        return self


class HorizonRequest(BaseModel):
    maturity: Date
    coupon_pct: float = Field(ge=0, le=25)
    frequency: Literal[1, 2, 4, 12] = 2
    day_count: DayCountName = "ACT/ACT-ICMA"
    settlement: Date
    horizon_date: Date
    ytm_start_pct: float = Field(ge=-5, le=50)
    ytm_end_pct: float = Field(ge=-5, le=50)
    reinvest_pct: float | None = Field(None, ge=-5, le=50)


class CashFlowIn(BaseModel):
    date: Date
    amount: float


class CustomCashFlowRequest(BaseModel):
    settlement: Date
    flows: list[CashFlowIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    compounding: Literal["1", "2", "4", "12", "continuous"] = "2"
    mode: Literal["yield", "price", "curve"] = "yield"
    ytm_pct: float | None = Field(None, ge=-5, le=50)
    price: float | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()


class SpotCurveRequest(BaseModel):
    years: list[float] = Field(min_length=2)
    rates_pct: list[float] = Field(min_length=2)
    compounding: Literal["1", "2", "4", "12", "continuous"] = "2"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _len(self):
        if len(self.years) != len(self.rates_pct):
            raise ValueError("years and rates_pct must have equal length")
        return self


class PolicyParams(BaseModel):
    policy_move_bp: float = Field(ge=-500, le=500)
    interpretation: str = "expected"
    priced_in: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=1)
    path_bp: float | None = Field(None, ge=-300, le=300)
    term_premium_bp: float | None = Field(None, ge=-300, le=300)
    transmission: str = "front_end"
    pass_through: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None
    overlay_kind: Literal["none", "parallel", "steepening", "flattening", "twist"] = "none"
    overlay_bp: float = Field(0.0, ge=-300, le=300)
    overlay_pivot: Tenor = "5Y"

    @field_validator("pass_through")
    @classmethod
    def _pt(cls, v):
        if v is not None:
            for t, b in v.items():
                if not -2 <= b <= 2:
                    raise ValueError(f"pass-through for {t} must be in [-2, 2]")
        return v


class PolicyRequest(PolicyParams):
    positions: list[PositionIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()


class HistoryApplyRequest(BaseModel):
    event_id: str | None = None
    start: Date | None = None
    end: Date | None = None
    portfolios: dict[str, list[PositionIn]] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    include_samples: bool = True
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()


class OptimizeRequest(BaseModel):
    objective: Literal["min_concentration", "match_krd", "risk_target", "max_yield"]
    capital: float = Field(100_000_000, gt=0, le=1e12)
    target_duration: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=30)
    max_weight: float = Field(0.4, gt=0, le=1)
    max_bucket_weight: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=1)
    long_only: bool = True
    universe_years: list[int] | None = None
    universe_positions: list[PositionIn] | None = None
    benchmark_positions: list[PositionIn] | None = None
    target_krd: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None
    krd_weights: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()

    @field_validator("universe_years")
    @classmethod
    def _yrs(cls, v):
        if v is not None:
            if not 2 <= len(v) <= 30 or any(y < 1 or y > 30 for y in v):
                raise ValueError("universe_years: 2-30 maturities, each 1-30 years")
        return v


class BarbellBulletRequest(BaseModel):
    target_years: int = Field(10, ge=2, le=29)
    short_years: int = Field(2, ge=1, le=29)
    long_years: int = Field(30, ge=2, le=30)
    notional: float = Field(100_000_000, gt=0)
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()


class ReportRequest(BaseModel):
    positions: list[PositionIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    portfolio_name: str = "Portfolio"
    curve: CurveSpec = CurveSpec()
    scenario_label: str = "Custom curve scenario"
    shocks_bp: dict[Tenor, float] | None = None
    policy: PolicyParams | None = None


def all_tenors() -> list[str]:
    return list(TENORS)

Environment variables
---------------------
MONETARY_DATA_MODE   "auto" (default) | "live" | "snapshot"
    auto     -> try official sources, fall back to the bundled snapshot (labeled)
    live     -> official sources only; errors propagate if unavailable
    snapshot -> never touch the network; bundled historical snapshot only
FRED_API_KEY         optional. If set, FRED's JSON API is used; otherwise the
                     keyless fredgraph.csv endpoint is used.
MONETARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT  seconds per HTTP request (default 20)
MONETARY_CORS_ORIGINS  comma-separated list of allowed frontend origins
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

BACKEND_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SNAPSHOT_DIR = BACKEND_ROOT / "data" / "snapshot"


def _csv_env(name: str, default: str) -> list[str]:
    raw = os.environ.get(name, default)
    return [s.strip() for s in raw.split(",") if s.strip()]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    data_mode: str = field(default_factory=lambda: os.environ.get("MONETARY_DATA_MODE", "auto").lower())
    fred_api_key: str | None = field(default_factory=lambda: os.environ.get("FRED_API_KEY") or None)
    http_timeout: float = field(default_factory=lambda: float(os.environ.get("MONETARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT", "20")))
    cors_origins: list[str] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: _csv_env(
            "MONETARY_CORS_ORIGINS", "http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000"
        )
    )
    # In-memory cache refresh intervals (seconds) per source. Treasury publishes the daily par
    # curve once per business day (~ after 3:30pm ET); FRED macro series are

            raise ValueError(f"MONETARY_DATA_MODE must be auto|live|snapshot, got {self.data_mode!r}")

"""Bond cash-flow generation, yield-based valuation and analytic risk measures.

Conventions (stated once, used everywhere)
-----------------------------------------
* Prices are quoted per 100 of face value. Position values scale by face/100.
* Yields are decimals internally (0.045 = 4.50%). The API layer converts from
  percent; 1 basis point = 0.0001 = 0.01%.
* Yield-to-maturity uses the *street convention*: periodic compounding at the
  coupon frequency f, with fractional first period
      dirty = sum_k CF_k / (1 + y/f)^(w + k - 1)
  where w = (days settlement->next coupon) / (days in coupon period).
  (Treasury's own "simple interest in the final coupon period" convention
  is not used; the difference is limited to bonds in their last period.)
* Zero-coupon bonds are modeled as coupon = 0 with semiannual compounding
  (the U.S. STRIPS bond-equivalent convention).
* Duration and convexity are expressed in years / years^2 and are derivatives
  with respect to the bond's own yield, holding the settlement date fixed.
* DV01 (PVBP) is reported as a POSITIVE number: the price *decrease* for a
  1bp *increase* in yield. DV01 = D_mod * dirty price * 0.0001.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

from app.core.daycount import DayCount, accrual_fraction, days_30_360_us, year_fraction_act365
from app.core.schedule import coupon_schedule

BP = 1e-4


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FixedRateBond:
    maturity: date
    coupon_rate: float  # decimal, annual (0.0425 = 4.25%)
    frequency: int = 2
    day_count: DayCount = DayCount.ACT_ACT_ICMA
    redemption: float = 100.0  # per 100 face

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not (-0.01 <= self.coupon_rate <= 0.5):
            raise ValueError("coupon_rate must be a decimal between -1% and 50% (e.g. 0.0425)")
        if self.frequency not in (1, 2, 4, 12):
            raise ValueError("frequency must be 1, 2, 4 or 12")


def zero_coupon_bond(maturity: date) -> FixedRateBond:
    return FixedRateBond(maturity=maturity, coupon_rate=0.0, frequency=2)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CashFlows:
    """Remaining cash flows of an instrument as of a settlement date (per 100 face)."""

    settlement: date
    dates: tuple[date, ...]
    amounts: np.ndarray
    years: np.ndarray  # time from settlement in years (periods / f for bonds)
    compounding: int | None  # periods per year used to discount at a yield; None = continuous
    accrued: float = 0.0
    previous_coupon: date | None = None
    next_coupon: date | None = None
    accrual_fraction: float = 0.0


def bond_cash_flows(bond: FixedRateBond, settlement: date) -> CashFlows:
    sched = coupon_schedule(settlement, bond.maturity, bond.frequency)
    f = bond.frequency
    coupon = 100.0 * bond.coupon_rate / f
    prev, nxt = sched.previous_coupon, sched.next_coupon
    af = accrual_fraction(bond.day_count, prev, nxt, settlement, f)
    accrued = coupon * af
    # Fraction of the current period remaining, on the convention's own day basis.
    if bond.day_count == DayCount.THIRTY_360:
        den = days_30_360_us(prev, nxt)
        w = days_30_360_us(settlement, nxt) / den
    else:
        w = (nxt - settlement).days / (nxt - prev).days
    n = len(sched.payment_dates)
    periods = w + np.arange(n, dtype=float)
    amounts = np.full(n, coupon)
    amounts[-1] += bond.redemption
    return CashFlows(
        settlement=settlement,
        dates=sched.payment_dates,
        amounts=amounts,
        years=periods / f,
        compounding=f,
        accrued=accrued,
        previous_coupon=prev,
        next_coupon=nxt,
        accrual_fraction=af,
    )


def custom_cash_flows(
    settlement: date, dates: list[date], amounts: list[float], compounding: int | None = 2
) -> CashFlows:
    """Arbitrary cash flows; time measured ACT/365F; flows on/before settlement are dropped."""
    if len(dates) != len(amounts):
        raise ValueError("dates and amounts must have equal length")
    pairs = sorted((d, float(a)) for d, a in zip(dates, amounts) if d > settlement)
    if not pairs:
        raise ValueError("no cash flows after settlement")
    ds = tuple(p[0] for p in pairs)
    am = np.array([p[1] for p in pairs])
    yrs = np.array([year_fraction_act365(settlement, d) for d in ds])
    return CashFlows(settlement=settlement, dates=ds, amounts=am, years=yrs, compounding=compounding)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- yield math

def discount_factors_at_yield(years: np.ndarray, y: float, compounding: int | None) -> np.ndarray:
    if compounding is None:
        return np.exp(-y * years)
    base = 1.0 + y / compounding
    if base <= 0:
        raise ValueError("yield too negative for the compounding frequency")
    return base ** (-compounding * years)


def dirty_price_at_yield(cf: CashFlows, y: float) -> float:
    return float(np.dot(cf.amounts, discount_factors_at_yield(cf.years, y, cf.compounding)))


def yield_from_dirty_price(cf: CashFlows, dirty: float, lo: float = -0.5, hi: float = 3.0) -> float:
    """Solve for YTM with Brent's method (bracketed, guaranteed convergence)."""
    if dirty <= 0:
        raise ValueError("price must be positive")
    g = lambda y: dirty_price_at_yield(cf, y) - dirty  # noqa: E731 - monotone decreasing in y
    if cf.compounding is not None:
        lo = max(lo, -0.99 * cf.compounding)
    if g(lo) * g(hi) > 0:
        raise ValueError("price is outside the range implied by yields in [-50%, 300%]")
    return float(brentq(g, lo, hi, xtol=1e-14, rtol=1e-15, maxiter=500))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class YieldRisk:
    dirty: float
    clean: float
    accrued: float
    ytm: float
    macaulay: float  # years
    modified: float  # years
    convexity: float  # years^2
    dv01: float  # per 100 face, positive = loss for +1bp
    dollar_duration: float  # D_mod * dirty (per 100 face) -- price change per 1.00 (100%) yield change


def risk_at_yield(cf: CashFlows, y: float) -> YieldRisk:
    t = cf.years
    m = cf.compounding
    dfs = discount_factors_at_yield(t, y, m)
    pv = cf.amounts * dfs
    p = float(pv.sum())
    mac = float(np.dot(t, pv) / p)
    if m is None:
        mod = mac
        conv = float(np.dot(t * t, pv) / p)
    else:
        g = 1.0 + y / m
        mod = mac / g
        conv = float(np.dot(t * (t + 1.0 / m), pv) / (p * g * g))
    return YieldRisk(
        dirty=p,
        clean=p - cf.accrued,
        accrued=cf.accrued,
        ytm=y,
        macaulay=mac,
        modified=mod,
        convexity=conv,
        dv01=mod * p * BP,
        dollar_duration=mod * p,
    )


def analyze_bond_at_yield(bond: FixedRateBond, settlement: date, ytm: float) -> YieldRisk:
    return risk_at_yield(bond_cash_flows(bond, settlement), ytm)


def analyze_bond_at_price(bond: FixedRateBond, settlement: date, clean_price: float) -> YieldRisk:
    cf = bond_cash_flows(bond, settlement)
    y = yield_from_dirty_price(cf, clean_price + cf.accrued)
    return risk_at_yield(cf, y)


def approximation_table(cf: CashFlows, y: float, shocks_bp: list[float]) -> list[dict]:
    """Compare full repricing vs duration and duration+convexity approximations.

    dP/P ~= -D_mod * dy                      (first order)
    dP/P ~= -D_mod * dy + 0.5 * C * dy^2     (second order)
    """
    base = risk_at_yield(cf, y)
    rows = []
    for s in shocks_bp:
        dy = s * BP
        full = dirty_price_at_yield(cf, y + dy)
        ret_full = full / base.dirty - 1.0
        ret_dur = -base.modified * dy
        ret_cvx = ret_dur + 0.5 * base.convexity * dy * dy
        rows.append(
            {
                "shock_bp": s,
                "yield": y + dy,
                "full_price": full,
                "full_return": ret_full,
                "duration_return": ret_dur,
                "convexity_return": ret_cvx,
                "duration_price": base.dirty * (1 + ret_dur),
                "convexity_price": base.dirty * (1 + ret_cvx),
                "duration_error_bp_of_price": (ret_dur - ret_full) * 1e4,
                "convexity_error_bp_of_price": (ret_cvx - ret_full) * 1e4,
            }
        )
    return rows


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- horizon return

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HorizonReturn:
    horizon_date: date
    initial_dirty: float
    final_dirty: float
    coupons_received: float
    reinvestment_income: float
    accrued_change: float
    accretion_rolldown: float  # clean price change at constant yield (pull-to-par)
    rate_effect: float  # clean price change from the yield change at the horizon
    total: float
    total_return: float  # decimal, over the horizon (not annualized)


def horizon_return(
    bond: FixedRateBond,
    settlement: date,
    horizon_date: date,
    y0: float,
    y1: float,
    reinvest_rate: float | None = None,
) -> HorizonReturn:
    """Decompose total return per 100 face over [settlement, horizon] into carry and price effects.

    total = coupons + reinvestment + (AI_1 - AI_0) + [clean(h, y0) - clean(0, y0)] + [clean(h, y1) - clean(h, y0)]

    The identity holds exactly. Coupons paid before the horizon are reinvested at
    ``reinvest_rate`` (simple interest, ACT/365F; default = y0) until the horizon.
    """
    if not (settlement < horizon_date < bond.maturity):
        raise ValueError("horizon must fall strictly between settlement and maturity")
    cf0 = bond_cash_flows(bond, settlement)
    r0 = risk_at_yield(cf0, y0)
    cfh = bond_cash_flows(bond, horizon_date)
    ph_y0 = risk_at_yield(cfh, y0)
    ph_y1 = risk_at_yield(cfh, y1)
    rr = y0 if reinvest_rate is None else reinvest_rate
    coupons = 0.0
    reinv = 0.0
    for d, a in zip(cf0.dates, cf0.amounts):
        if settlement < d <= horizon_date:
            coupons += a
            reinv += a * rr * year_fraction_act365(d, horizon_date)
    accrued_change = cfh.accrued - cf0.accrued
    accretion = ph_y0.clean - r0.clean
    rate = ph_y1.clean - ph_y0.clean
    total = coupons + reinv + accrued_change + accretion + rate
    return HorizonReturn(
        horizon_date=horizon_date,
        initial_dirty=r0.dirty,
        final_dirty=ph_y1.dirty,
        coupons_received=coupons,
        reinvestment_income=reinv,
        accrued_change=accrued_change,
        accretion_rolldown=accretion,
        rate_effect=rate,
        total=total,
        total_return=total / r0.dirty,
    )

"""Day-count conventions.

All functions take ``datetime.date`` objects and are pure/deterministic.

Supported conventions
---------------------
ACT/ACT-ICMA  U.S. Treasury notes & bonds. Accrual fraction of a coupon period
              is (actual days since last coupon) / (actual days in the period).
30/360        U.S. (bond basis / SIFMA) - corporate & agency bonds.
ACT/360       money-market convention.
ACT/365F      fixed 365-day year; used for continuous-time cash-flow timing.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from enum import Enum


class DayCount(str, Enum):
    ACT_ACT_ICMA = "ACT/ACT-ICMA"
    THIRTY_360 = "30/360"
    ACT_360 = "ACT/360"
    ACT_365F = "ACT/365F"


def days_30_360_us(d1: date, d2: date) -> int:
    """30/360 US (Bond Basis) day count, per SIFMA / ISDA 2006 4.16(f)."""
    y1, m1, dd1 = d1.year, d1.month, d1.day
    y2, m2, dd2 = d2.year, d2.month, d2.day
    if dd1 == 31:
        dd1 = 30
    if dd2 == 31 and dd1 >= 30:
        dd2 = 30
    return 360 * (y2 - y1) + 30 * (m2 - m1) + (dd2 - dd1)


def accrual_fraction(
    convention: DayCount, period_start: date, period_end: date, accrual_end: date, frequency: int
) -> float:
    """Fraction of the coupon *period* elapsed between ``period_start`` and ``accrual_end``.

    Accrued interest = (annual coupon / frequency) * accrual_fraction.
    For ACT/360 and ACT/365F the fraction is expressed relative to a nominal
    period of (year basis / frequency) days, so a full period can differ
    slightly from 1.0 -- that is the defining property of those conventions.
    """
    if not (period_start <= accrual_end <= period_end):
        raise ValueError("accrual_end must lie within the coupon period")
    if frequency <= 0:
        raise ValueError("frequency must be positive")
    if convention == DayCount.ACT_ACT_ICMA:
        return (accrual_end - period_start).days / (period_end - period_start).days
    if convention == DayCount.THIRTY_360:
        num = days_30_360_us(period_start, accrual_end)
        den = days_30_360_us(period_start, period_end)
        return num / den if den else 0.0
    if convention == DayCount.ACT_360:
        return (accrual_end - period_start).days * frequency / 360.0
    if convention == DayCount.ACT_365F:
        return (accrual_end - period_start).days * frequency / 365.0
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported day count {convention}")


def year_fraction_act365(d1: date, d2: date) -> float:
    return (d2 - d1).days / 365.0

"""Historical policy-episode analysis.

Three things are kept strictly separate in every result:
1. ``observed``      -- actual Treasury par-yield changes between two dates.
2. ``hypothetical``  -- P&L from applying those observed changes, as an
                        instantaneous shock, to a portfolio valued on the
                        CURRENT curve. This is a stress test, not a backtest:
                        it ignores carry, roll-down, the historical curve level,
                        reinvestment, and any trading.
3. ``assumptions``   -- anything inferred where data were unavailable (e.g. a
                        tenor not published in the window), explicitly listed.

Date alignment: for each window endpoint the last observation ON OR BEFORE
the requested date is used, so no information after the endpoint is used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from app.core.portfolio import Position, run_scenario
from app.data.sources import TENOR_YEARS, TENORS
from app.data.store import MarketDataStore

HYPOTHETICAL_DISCLAIMER = (
    "Hypothetical stress test: the observed par-yield changes from the historical window are applied "
    "instantaneously to today's portfolio on today's curve. This is not a backtest - it ignores the "
    "historical curve level, coupon carry, roll-down, reinvestment, and trading over the window."
)


def observed_changes(store: MarketDataStore, start: date, end: date) -> dict:
    if end <= start:
        raise ValueError("window end must be after start")
    d0 = store.resolve_curve_date(start)
    d1 = store.resolve_curve_date(end)
    if d1 <= d0:
        raise ValueError("no Treasury observations inside the requested window")
    y0 = store.curve_row_pct(d0)
    y1 = store.curve_row_pct(d1)
    changes: dict[str, float | None] = {}
    for t in TENORS:
        changes[t] = None if (y0[t] is None or y1[t] is None) else round((y1[t] - y0[t]) * 100, 2)
    p0 = store.policy_range_on(d0)
    p1 = store.policy_range_on(d1)
    path = store.curve_history(d0, d1, ["3M", "2Y", "10Y", "30Y"])
    path_rows = [
        {"date": ix.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), **{c: (None if pd.isna(v) else float(v)) for c, v in row.items()}}
        for ix, row in path.iterrows()
    ]
    # policy range path for the timeline chart
    up = store.series("DFEDTARU") if pd.Timestamp(d1) >= store.series("DFEDTARU").index.min() else None
    return {
        "start_requested": start.isoformat(),
        "end_requested": end.isoformat(),
        "start_observed": d0.isoformat(),
        "end_observed": d1.isoformat(),
        "yields_start_pct": y0,
        "yields_end_pct": y1,
        "changes_bp": changes,
        "spread_2s10s_bp": {
            "start": _spread(y0, "10Y", "2Y"), "end": _spread(y1, "10Y", "2Y"),
        },
        "spread_3m10y_bp": {
            "start": _spread(y0, "10Y", "3M"), "end": _spread(y1, "10Y", "3M"),
        },
        "policy_start": p0,
        "policy_end": p1,
        "policy_change_bp": round((p1["upper"] - p0["upper"]) * 100),
        "path": path_rows,
        "policy_series_used": "DFEDTARU/DFEDTARL" if up is not None else "DFEDTAR",
    }


def _spread(y: dict, a: str, b: str) -> float | None:
    if y.get(a) is None or y.get(b) is None:
        return None
    return round((y[a] - y[b]) * 100, 2)


def fill_missing_shocks(changes: dict[str, float | None]) -> tuple[dict[str, float], list[str]]:
    """Interpolate shocks for tenors without observations; return the list of filled tenors.

    This is an explicit, labeled assumption -- used only to build a shock for a
    current curve that has those tenors.
    """
    have = [(TENOR_YEARS[t], v) for t, v in changes.items() if v is not None]
    if len(have) < 2:
        raise ValueError("not enough observed tenors in the window to build a shock")
    xs, ys = zip(*sorted(have))
    filled, out = [], {}
    for t in TENORS:
        if changes.get(t) is None:
            out[t] = float(np.interp(TENOR_YEARS[t], xs, ys))
            filled.append(t)
        else:
            out[t] = float(changes[t])
    return out, filled


def apply_to_portfolios(
    store: MarketDataStore,
    start: date,
    end: date,
    portfolios: dict[str, list[Position]],
    curve_date: date | None,
    settlement: date,
) -> dict:
    obs = observed_changes(store, start, end)
    shocks, filled = fill_missing_shocks(obs["changes_bp"])
    par, as_of = store.curve_on(curve_date)
    results = {}
    for name, positions in portfolios.items():
        sc = run_scenario(positions, par, shocks, settlement)
        results[name] = {
            "market_value_before": sc["base"]["summary"]["market_value"],
            "pnl_full": sc["totals"]["pnl_full"],
            "return_full": sc["totals"]["return_full"],
            "pnl_krd_approx": sc["totals"]["pnl_krd_approx"],
            "duration": sc["base"]["summary"]["modified_duration"],
            "dv01": sc["base"]["summary"]["dv01"],
            "by_security": sc["pnl"],
        }
    assumptions = []
    if filled:
        assumptions.append(
            "Tenors without observations in the window were assigned shocks by linear interpolation "
            "(in maturity) of observed tenor changes: " + ", ".join(filled)
        )
    return {
        "observed": obs,
        "hypothetical": {
            "valuation_curve_as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
            "settlement": settlement.isoformat(),
            "shocks_bp": shocks,
            "results": results,
            "disclaimer": HYPOTHETICAL_DISCLAIMER,
        },
        "assumptions": assumptions,
    }

"""Macro / monetary research dashboard analytics.

Alignment rules (documented, deterministic):
* Daily series (yields, spreads, effective fed funds) are converted to MONTHLY
  AVERAGES of available daily observations, indexed to the first of the month.
* Inflation is the 12-month percent change of the seasonally adjusted price
  index (CPIAUCSL, PCEPILFE): 100 * (I_t / I_{t-12} - 1).
* Monthly macro data are indexed by the reference month, not the release date.
  CPI/PCE/unemployment are published with a lag of roughly 2-6 weeks, so a
  contemporaneous correlation uses information not available in real time at
  the start of the month. The optional ``lag_months`` shifts the indicator
  forward (indicator at t - lag vs. yield at t) to study lead/lag relations.

Correlation is descriptive. It does not establish causation, and monthly
macro/yield series are highly autocorrelated, so conventional significance
tests on levels are unreliable (spurious-regression problem, Granger & Newbold
1974). We report the number of observations, not p-values.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from app.data.store import MarketDataStore

INDICATORS: dict[str, dict] = {
    "fed_funds": {"label": "Effective federal funds rate", "units": "%", "series": "DFF", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
    "fed_target_upper": {"label": "Fed target (upper bound / point target)", "units": "%", "series": "TARGET", "transform": "monthly_last"},
    "cpi_yoy": {"label": "CPI inflation (YoY)", "units": "%", "series": "CPIAUCSL", "transform": "yoy"},
    "core_pce_yoy": {"label": "Core PCE inflation (YoY)", "units": "%", "series": "PCEPILFE", "transform": "yoy"},
    "unemployment": {"label": "Unemployment rate", "units": "%", "series": "UNRATE", "transform": "level"},
    "ust_3m": {"label": "3-Month Treasury (CMT)", "units": "%", "series": "DGS3MO", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
    "ust_2y": {"label": "2-Year Treasury (CMT)", "units": "%", "series": "DGS2", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
    "ust_10y": {"label": "10-Year Treasury (CMT)", "units": "%", "series": "DGS10", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
    "spread_10y2y": {"label": "10Y - 2Y spread", "units": "pp", "series": "T10Y2Y", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
    "spread_10y3m": {"label": "10Y - 3M spread", "units": "pp", "series": "T10Y3M", "transform": "monthly_avg"},
}


def _target_series(store: MarketDataStore) -> pd.Series:
    old = store.series("DFEDTAR")
    new = store.series("DFEDTARU")
    return pd.concat([old[old.index < new.index.min()], new]).sort_index()


def monthly_indicator(store: MarketDataStore, key: str) -> pd.Series:
    meta = INDICATORS[key]
    s = _target_series(store) if meta["series"] == "TARGET" else store.series(meta["series"])
    tr = meta["transform"]
    if tr == "monthly_avg":
        out = s.resample("MS").mean()
    elif tr == "monthly_last":
        out = s.resample("MS").last()
    elif tr == "yoy":
        m = s.resample("MS").last()
        out = (m / m.shift(12) - 1.0) * 100.0
        # require exactly 12 calendar months between observations
        out = out[m.index.to_series().diff(12).dt.days.between(334, 366)]
    else:
        out = s.resample("MS").last()
    out.name = key
    return out.dropna()


def describe(s: pd.Series) -> dict:
    if s.empty:
        return {"n": 0}
    return {
        "n": int(s.size), "mean": float(s.mean()), "std": float(s.std(ddof=1)) if s.size > 1 else None,
        "min": float(s.min()), "p25": float(s.quantile(0.25)), "median": float(s.median()),
        "p75": float(s.quantile(0.75)), "max": float(s.max()), "last": float(s.iloc[-1]),
        "last_date": s.index[-1].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "first_date": s.index[0].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    }


def dashboard(
    store: MarketDataStore,
    x_key: str,
    y_key: str,
    start: date | None,
    end: date | None,
    window: int = 36,
    lag_months: int = 0,
    change_horizon: int = 12,
) -> dict:
    for k in (x_key, y_key):
        if k not in INDICATORS:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown indicator {k!r}")
    if window < 6 or window > 240:
        raise ValueError("rolling window must be between 6 and 240 months")
    if not 0 <= lag_months <= 24:
        raise ValueError("lag must be between 0 and 24 months")
    x = monthly_indicator(store, x_key).shift(lag_months, freq="MS")
    y = monthly_indicator(store, y_key)
    df = pd.concat([x.rename("x"), y.rename("y")], axis=1, join="inner").dropna()
    if start:
        df = df[df.index >= pd.Timestamp(start)]
    if end:
        df = df[df.index <= pd.Timestamp(end)]
    if len(df) < 12:
        raise ValueError("fewer than 12 overlapping monthly observations in the selected range")
    dx = df["x"].diff(change_horizon)
    dy = df["y"].diff(change_horizon)
    ch = pd.concat([dx, dy], axis=1).dropna()
    roll = df["x"].rolling(window).corr(df["y"]).dropna()
    roll_ch = dx.rolling(window).corr(dy).dropna()
    return {
        "x": {"key": x_key, **INDICATORS[x_key], "stats": describe(df["x"]), "lag_months": lag_months},
        "y": {"key": y_key, **INDICATORS[y_key], "stats": describe(df["y"])},
        "observations": [
            {"date": ix.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "x": float(r.x), "y": float(r.y)} for ix, r in df.iterrows()
        ],
        "correlation_levels": float(df["x"].corr(df["y"])),
        "correlation_changes": float(ch.iloc[:, 0].corr(ch.iloc[:, 1])) if len(ch) > 2 else None,
        "change_horizon_months": change_horizon,
        "n_levels": int(len(df)),
        "n_changes": int(len(ch)),
        "rolling_window_months": window,
        "rolling_correlation_levels": [{"date": i.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "value": float(v)} for i, v in roll.items()],
        "rolling_correlation_changes": [{"date": i.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "value": float(v)} for i, v in roll_ch.items()],
        "methodology": [
            "Daily series converted to monthly averages; inflation = 12-month % change of SA index.",
            "Monthly macro data are indexed to the reference month, not the release date (release lags of ~2-6 weeks).",
            f"Change correlation uses {change_horizon}-month changes (overlapping), which are autocorrelated.",
            "Correlation is descriptive and does not establish causation; no p-values reported because the series are persistent.",
        ],
    }


def overview_series(store: MarketDataStore, start: date | None = None) -> dict:
    """All indicators on one monthly grid for the multi-line dashboard chart."""
    frames = {k: monthly_indicator(store, k) for k in INDICATORS}
    df = pd.concat(frames, axis=1)
    if start:
        df = df[df.index >= pd.Timestamp(start)]
    rows = []
    for ix, r in df.iterrows():
        rows.append({"date": ix.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), **{k: (None if pd.isna(v) else round(float(v), 4)) for k, v in r.items()}})
    latest = {k: describe(frames[k]) for k in INDICATORS}
    return {"rows": rows, "latest": latest, "indicators": INDICATORS}


def correlation_matrix(store: MarketDataStore, keys: list[str], start: date | None, end: date | None) -> dict:
    df = pd.concat({k: monthly_indicator(store, k) for k in keys}, axis=1).dropna()
    if start:
        df = df[df.index >= pd.Timestamp(start)]
    if end:
        df = df[df.index <= pd.Timestamp(end)]
    c = df.corr()
    return {"keys": keys, "matrix": np.round(c.to_numpy(), 4).tolist(), "n": int(len(df))}

"""Calculation-based commentary.

Every sentence is assembled from numbers computed by the engine. No economic
news, policy statements, forecasts or recommendations are generated. Wording
is deliberately conditional ("under the specified hypothetical...").
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.portfolio import MATURITY_BUCKETS
from app.core.scenarios import classify_move


def _money(x: float) -> str:
    if abs(x) < 0.5:
        return "$0"
    sign = "-" if x < 0 else ""
    x = abs(x)
    if x >= 1e9:
        return f"{sign}${x/1e9:,.2f}bn"
    if x >= 1e6:
        return f"{sign}${x/1e6:,.2f}mm"
    if x >= 1e3:
        return f"{sign}${x/1e3:,.1f}k"
    return f"{sign}${x:,.0f}"


def _bp(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:+.1f} bp"


def _bucket_of(years: float) -> str:
    for name, lo, hi in MATURITY_BUCKETS:
        if lo <= years < hi:
            return name
    return "30y+"


def scenario_commentary(sc: dict, policy: dict | None = None, policy_range: dict | None = None) -> list[str]:
    s = []
    shocks = sc["shocks_bp"]
    tot = sc["totals"]
    base = sc["base"]["summary"]
    if policy is not None:
        move = policy["policy_move_bp"]
        if move == 0:
            s.append("The hypothetical scenario assumes no change in the federal funds target range.")
        else:
            verb = "increase" if move > 0 else "reduction"
            line = f"The hypothetical scenario assumes a {abs(move):.0f} bp {verb} in the federal funds target range"
            if policy_range:
                lo, hi = policy_range["lower"], policy_range["upper"]
                line += f", from {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}% to {lo + move/100:.2f}-{hi + move/100:.2f}%"
            s.append(line + ".")
        s.append(
            f"Of that move, {abs(policy['expected_component_bp']):.0f} bp is assumed to be already priced in, leaving a "
            f"policy surprise of {policy['surprise_bp']:.0f} bp; yields also respond to the assumed revision of the "
            "expected policy path and term premium."
        )
        if move != 0 and "10Y" in shocks:
            ratio = shocks["10Y"] / move
            s.append(
                f"Under these assumptions the 2-year yield changes by {_bp(shocks.get('2Y', 0))} and the 10-year by "
                f"{_bp(shocks['10Y'])} - the 10-year moves {abs(ratio):.2f}x the policy-rate change"
                f"{' in the opposite direction' if ratio < 0 else ''}, not one-for-one."
            )
    move_name = classify_move(shocks)
    sb, sa = sc["curve_shape_before"], sc["curve_shape_after"]
    if sb["spread_2s10s_bp"] is not None and sa["spread_2s10s_bp"] is not None:
        s.append(
            f"The curve move is a {move_name}: the 10Y-2Y spread goes from {sb['spread_2s10s_bp']:.0f} bp to "
            f"{sa['spread_2s10s_bp']:.0f} bp ({sb['shape_2s10s']} -> {sa['shape_2s10s']})."
        )
    pnl = tot["pnl_full"]
    direction = "gains" if pnl > 0 else "loses" if pnl < 0 else "is unchanged at"
    s.append(
        f"On full cash-flow revaluation the portfolio {direction} {_money(abs(pnl))} "
        f"({tot['return_full']*100:+.2f}%) on a starting market value of {_money(base['market_value'])}."
    )
    rows = sorted(sc["pnl"], key=lambda r: abs(r["pnl_full"]), reverse=True)
    if rows and abs(pnl) > 0:
        top = rows[0]
        holdings = {h["id"]: h for h in sc["base"]["holdings"]}
        h = holdings.get(top["id"], {})
        bucket = _bucket_of(h.get("years_to_maturity", 0))
        bucket_pnl = sum(
            r["pnl_full"] for r in sc["pnl"] if _bucket_of(holdings[r["id"]]["years_to_maturity"]) == bucket
        )
        s.append(
            f"The largest contributor is {top['label']} ({_money(top['pnl_full'])}, "
            f"{top['share_of_pnl']*100:.0f}% of total P&L); the {bucket} maturity bucket accounts for "
            f"{bucket_pnl / pnl * 100:.0f}% of the result."
        )
    kr = tot["pnl_by_key_rate"]
    if kr:
        tmax = max(kr, key=lambda t: abs(kr[t]))
        if abs(kr[tmax]) > 0:
            s.append(
                f"By key rate, the {tmax} point explains the most first-order P&L ({_money(kr[tmax])}): the portfolio's "
                f"{tmax} key-rate DV01 of {_money(sc['base']['key_rate_dv01'][tmax])} per bp times a {_bp(shocks[tmax])} shock."
            )
    approx_err = tot["pnl_krd_approx"] - pnl
    s.append(
        f"A first-order key-rate duration estimate gives {_money(tot['pnl_krd_approx'])} and adding convexity gives "
        f"{_money(tot['pnl_krd_convexity_approx'])}, versus {_money(pnl)} on full revaluation "
        f"(first-order error {_money(approx_err)})."
    )
    s.append(
        f"Portfolio modified duration moves from {base['modified_duration']:.2f} to "
        f"{sc['shocked']['summary']['modified_duration']:.2f} years and DV01 from {_money(base['dv01'])} to "
        f"{_money(sc['shocked']['summary']['dv01'])} per bp after the shock."
    )
    return s


def risk_observations(sc: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Analytical (non-prescriptive) portfolio-management implications."""
    out = []
    base = sc["base"]
    krdv = base["key_rate_dv01"]
    total = sum(krdv.values())
    if total > 0:
        t = max(krdv, key=lambda k: krdv[k])
        out.append(
            f"{krdv[t]/total*100:.0f}% of the portfolio's key-rate DV01 sits at the {t} point; P&L is most sensitive to "
            f"moves in that part of the curve."
        )
        sh = sc["shocks_bp"].get(t, 0.0)
        if sh:
            out.append(
                f"In this scenario, each $1,000 of {t} key-rate DV01 removed would change first-order scenario P&L by "
                f"about {_money(1000 * sh)}."
            )
    conc = base["concentration"]
    out.append(
        f"Market-value concentration: HHI {conc['hhi']:.3f} (effective number of positions {conc['effective_positions']:.1f}); "
        f"largest single DV01 share {conc['max_dv01_share']*100:.0f}%."
    )
    out.extend(conc["warnings"])
    cvx = base["summary"]["convexity"]
    out.append(
        f"Portfolio convexity of {cvx:.1f} adds roughly {0.5*cvx*(0.01**2)*100:.2f}% of value for a 100 bp parallel move "
        "in either direction, relative to the duration-only estimate."
    )

"""Portfolio optimization laboratory (risk-targeting, not return forecasting).

Decision variables: market-value weights w_i over a candidate universe.
All objectives are *risk-shape* objectives. None of them maximizes expected
return: doing so would require an explicit expected-return model, which this
application deliberately does not invent. The optional ``max_yield`` objective
maximizes the market-value-weighted yield to maturity -- yield is NOT expected
return (it ignores curve changes, roll-down and reinvestment), and the result
is labeled accordingly.

Solver: scipy.optimize.minimize(method="SLSQP"). Feasibility of the linear
constraint set is checked first with scipy.optimize.linprog (HiGHS), so an
infeasible specification is reported as such instead of as a solver failure.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog, minimize

from app.core.curve import ParCurve
from app.core.portfolio import MATURITY_BUCKETS, Position, _bond_at, analyze_portfolio
from app.core.risk import CurveSet

DEFAULT_UNIVERSE_YEARS = [1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 20, 30]
RIDGE = 1e-4  # disclosed regularization used where the objective alone is not strictly convex


@dataclass
class Universe:
    positions: list[Position]
    labels: list[str]
    mod_dur: np.ndarray
    convexity: np.ndarray
    ytm: np.ndarray  # percent
    dirty: np.ndarray
    krd: np.ndarray  # (n, k)
    tenors: list[str]
    years_to_maturity: np.ndarray


def build_universe(par: ParCurve, settlement: date, years: list[int] | None = None,
                   positions: list[Position] | None = None) -> Universe:
    if positions is None:
        years = years or DEFAULT_UNIVERSE_YEARS
        positions = [_bond_at(settlement, y, par, 1_000_000) for y in years]
    cs = CurveSet.build(par)
    a = analyze_portfolio(positions, par, settlement, cs)
    h = a["holdings"]
    tenors = list(par.tenors)
    return Universe(
        positions=positions,
        labels=[r["label"] for r in h],
        mod_dur=np.array([r["modified_duration"] for r in h]),
        convexity=np.array([r["convexity"] for r in h]),
        ytm=np.array([r["ytm_pct"] for r in h]),
        dirty=np.array([r["dirty_price"] for r in h]),
        krd=np.array([[r["krd"][t] for t in tenors] for r in h]),
        tenors=tenors,
        years_to_maturity=np.array([r["years_to_maturity"] for r in h]),
    )


def _constraints(u: Universe, target_duration: float | None, max_bucket_weight: float | None):
    """Return (A_eq, b_eq, A_ub, b_ub, descriptions)."""
    n = len(u.positions)
    a_eq, b_eq, a_ub, b_ub, desc = [np.ones(n)], [1.0], [], [], ["sum(w) = 1 (fully invested)"]
    if target_duration is not None:
        a_eq.append(u.mod_dur)
        b_eq.append(target_duration)
        desc.append(f"sum(w_i * Dmod_i) = {target_duration:.3f} (duration target)")
    if max_bucket_weight is not None and max_bucket_weight < 1:
        for name, lo, hi in MATURITY_BUCKETS:
            sel = ((u.years_to_maturity >= lo) & (u.years_to_maturity < hi)).astype(float)
            if sel.sum() > 0:
                a_ub.append(sel)
                b_ub.append(max_bucket_weight)
        desc.append(f"sum of weights in each maturity bucket <= {max_bucket_weight:.0%}")
    return np.array(a_eq), np.array(b_eq), (np.array(a_ub) if a_ub else None), (np.array(b_ub) if b_ub else None), desc


def optimize(
    u: Universe,
    objective: str,
    capital: float,
    target_duration: float | None = None,
    max_weight: float = 1.0,
    long_only: bool = True,
    max_bucket_weight: float | None = None,
    target_krd: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    krd_weights: dict[str, float] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    n = len(u.positions)
    if capital <= 0:
        raise ValueError("capital must be positive")
    if not 0 < max_weight <= 1:
        raise ValueError("max_weight must be in (0, 1]")
    lo = 0.0 if long_only else -max_weight
    bounds = [(lo, max_weight)] * n
    a_eq, b_eq, a_ub, b_ub, cdesc = _constraints(u, target_duration, max_bucket_weight)
    cdesc.append(f"{lo:.0%} <= w_i <= {max_weight:.0%} per security" + (" (long-only)" if long_only else ""))

    feas = linprog(np.zeros(n), A_ub=a_ub, b_ub=b_ub, A_eq=a_eq, b_eq=b_eq, bounds=bounds, method="highs")
    base = {
        "objective": objective,
        "constraints": cdesc,
        "inputs": {
            "universe": u.labels,
            "modified_duration": u.mod_dur.tolist(),
            "ytm_pct": u.ytm.tolist(),
            "capital": capital,
            "target_duration": target_duration,
            "max_weight": max_weight,
            "long_only": long_only,
            "max_bucket_weight": max_bucket_weight,
        },
    }
    if feas.status != 0:
        dmin, dmax = float(u.mod_dur.min()), float(u.mod_dur.max())
        return {
            **base,
            "status": "infeasible",
            "solver_message": f"Linear feasibility check failed: {feas.message}",
            "hint": f"Universe durations span {dmin:.2f}-{dmax:.2f}y; with the weight limits the target may be unreachable.",
        }

    k = u.krd  # (n, K)
    tenors = u.tenors
    if objective == "min_concentration":
        if target_duration is None:
            raise ValueError("min_concentration requires a target duration")
        fun = lambda w: float(w @ w)  # noqa: E731
        jac = lambda w: 2 * w  # noqa: E731
        formula = "minimize sum(w_i^2)  (Herfindahl index of market-value weights)"
    elif objective in ("match_krd", "risk_target"):
        if not target_krd:
            raise ValueError(f"{objective} requires target key-rate durations")
        tgt = np.array([target_krd.get(t, 0.0) for t in tenors])
        om = np.array([(krd_weights or {}).get(t, 1.0) for t in tenors])

        def fun(w):
            e = w @ k - tgt
            return float(np.sum(om * e * e) + RIDGE * w @ w)

        def jac(w):
            e = w @ k - tgt
            return 2 * k @ (om * e) + 2 * RIDGE * w

        formula = (
            "minimize sum_k omega_k (KRD_p,k - KRD_target,k)^2 + "
            f"{RIDGE:g} * sum(w_i^2)   [ridge term disclosed: selects the least-concentrated solution among near-ties]"
        )
    elif objective == "max_yield":
        fun = lambda w: float(-(w @ u.ytm) + RIDGE * w @ w)  # noqa: E731
        jac = lambda w: -u.ytm + 2 * RIDGE * w  # noqa: E731
        formula = (
            f"maximize sum(w_i * YTM_i) - {RIDGE:g} * sum(w_i^2).  NOTE: yield-to-maturity is not expected return; "
            "this is not a risk-adjusted return optimization."
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown objective {objective!r}")

    cons = [{"type": "eq", "fun": (lambda w, a=a, b=b: a @ w - b), "jac": (lambda w, a=a: a)} for a, b in zip(a_eq, b_eq)]
    if a_ub is not None:
        cons += [{"type": "ineq", "fun": (lambda w, a=a, b=b: b - a @ w), "jac": (lambda w, a=a: -a)} for a, b in zip(a_ub, b_ub)]
    x0 = np.clip(np.asarray(feas.x, dtype=float), lo, max_weight)
    res = minimize(fun, x0, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, constraints=cons, method="SLSQP",
                   options={"ftol": 1e-12, "maxiter": 1000})
    w = np.where(np.abs(res.x) < 1e-8, 0.0, res.x)
    eq_resid = (a_eq @ w - b_eq).tolist()
    ub_resid = (a_ub @ w - b_ub).tolist() if a_ub is not None else []
    face = w * capital / (u.dirty / 100.0)
    allocations = [
        {"label": lab, "weight": float(wi), "market_value": float(wi * capital), "face_amount": float(fi),
         "modified_duration": float(d), "ytm_pct": float(y)}
        for lab, wi, fi, d, y in zip(u.labels, w, face, u.mod_dur, u.ytm)
    ]
    port_krd = (w @ k).tolist()
    return {
        **base,
        "status": "optimal" if res.success else "solver_failed",
        "solver": {"method": "SLSQP", "success": bool(res.success), "message": str(res.message),
                   "iterations": int(res.nit), "objective_value": float(res.fun)},
        "objective_formula": formula,
        "constraint_residuals": {"equality": eq_resid, "inequality_slack_violation": [max(0.0, r) for r in ub_resid]},
        "allocations": allocations,
        "portfolio": {
            "modified_duration": float(w @ u.mod_dur),
            "convexity": float(w @ u.convexity),
            "mv_weighted_ytm_pct": float(w @ u.ytm),
            "hhi": float(w @ w),
            "krd": dict(zip(tenors, port_krd)),
            "target_krd": target_krd,
        },
        "positions": [
            {"id": p.id, "label": p.label, "coupon_pct": p.coupon_rate * 100, "maturity": p.maturity.isoformat(),
             "face_amount": float(f)}
            for p, f in zip(u.positions, face) if abs(f) > 1e-6
        ],
        "assumptions": [
            "Weights are market-value weights; risk measures are linear in weights (static, instantaneous).",
            "Candidate bonds are hypothetical Treasury-style par bonds at each tenor (coupon = par yield rounded to 1/8%) unless user holdings are supplied.",
            "No transaction costs, bid-ask spreads, financing, or expected-return model.",
        ],
    }


def barbell_vs_bullet(par: ParCurve, settlement: date, target_years: int = 10, short_years: int = 2,
                      long_years: int = 30, notional: float = 100_000_000) -> dict:
    """Duration-matched barbell vs bullet comparison (weights solved analytically)."""
    bullet = [_bond_at(settlement, target_years, par, notional)]
    ab = analyze_portfolio(bullet, par, settlement)
    d_t = ab["summary"]["modified_duration"]
    mv = ab["summary"]["market_value"]
    trial = analyze_portfolio([_bond_at(settlement, short_years, par, 1e6), _bond_at(settlement, long_years, par, 1e6)], par, settlement)
    ds, dl = (h["modified_duration"] for h in trial["holdings"])
    ps, pl = (h["dirty_price"] for h in trial["holdings"])
    if not (ds < d_t < dl):
        raise ValueError("bullet duration must lie between the barbell wings' durations")
    wl = (d_t - ds) / (dl - ds)
    ws = 1 - wl
    barbell = [_bond_at(settlement, short_years, par, ws * mv / ps * 100), _bond_at(settlement, long_years, par, wl * mv / pl * 100)]
    return {"bullet": bullet, "barbell": barbell, "weights": {"short": ws, "long": wl}, "target_duration": d_t}

"""Portfolio construction, aggregation and scenario repricing.

Valuation assumptions (returned with every result):
* Static positions: holdings are fixed; no trading, rebalancing or carry.
* Every security is a Treasury-style fixed-rate bond (no credit or optionality)
  valued by discounting each cash flow on the bootstrapped Treasury zero curve
  with zero spread. Its YTM is then solved from that model price.
* Scenario shocks are instantaneous and applied to par yields at published
  tenors; the zero curve is re-bootstrapped and all cash flows re-discounted
  (full revaluation). Duration-based approximations are shown alongside, never
  instead of, full revaluation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

import numpy as np

from app.core.bond import (
    BP,
    CashFlows,
    FixedRateBond,
    bond_cash_flows,
    risk_at_yield,
    yield_from_dirty_price,
)
from app.core.curve import ParCurve, bootstrap, curve_shape
from app.core.daycount import DayCount
from app.core.risk import CurveSet, curve_risk, price_on_curve

MATURITY_BUCKETS: list[tuple[str, float, float]] = [
    ("0-1y", 0, 1), ("1-3y", 1, 3), ("3-5y", 3, 5), ("5-7y", 5, 7),
    ("7-10y", 7, 10), ("10-20y", 10, 20), ("20-30y", 20, 30.5),
]

# Concentration thresholds (documented, adjustable defaults).
MAX_WEIGHT_WARN = 0.35
MAX_DV01_SHARE_WARN = 0.50

VALUATION_ASSUMPTIONS = [
    "Static positions: no trading, coupon reinvestment, or rebalancing within the analysis.",
    "Securities are Treasury-style fixed-rate bonds valued on the bootstrapped Treasury zero curve with zero spread.",
    "Scenario shocks are instantaneous and applied to published par-yield tenors; the zero curve is re-bootstrapped and all cash flows fully re-discounted.",
    "Key-rate risk uses +/-1bp triangular bumps of the par curve (Ho, 1992).",
    "Settlement-date accrued interest uses ACT/ACT (ICMA) unless a position specifies otherwise.",
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Position:
    id: str
    label: str
    coupon_rate: float  # decimal
    maturity: date
    face_amount: float  # currency units of face
    frequency: int = 2
    day_count: DayCount = DayCount.ACT_ACT_ICMA

    @property
    def bond(self) -> FixedRateBond:
        return FixedRateBond(self.maturity, self.coupon_rate, self.frequency, self.day_count)


@dataclass
class _Priced:
    pos: Position
    cf: CashFlows
    dirty: float
    ytm: float


def _price_positions(positions: list[Position], cs: CurveSet, settlement: date) -> list[_Priced]:
    out = []
    for p in positions:
        if p.maturity <= settlement:
            raise ValueError(f"position {p.label!r} has matured on or before settlement {settlement}")
        if p.face_amount < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"position {p.label!r}: short positions are not supported (face < 0)")
        cf = bond_cash_flows(p.bond, settlement)
        dirty = price_on_curve(cf, cs.base)
        out.append(_Priced(p, cf, dirty, yield_from_dirty_price(cf, dirty)))
    return out


def _years(settlement: date, d: date) -> float:
    return (d - settlement).days / 365.25


def analyze_portfolio(
    positions: list[Position], par: ParCurve, settlement: date, cs: CurveSet | None = None
) -> dict:
    if not positions:
        raise ValueError("portfolio is empty")
    cs = cs or CurveSet.build(par)
    priced = _price_positions(positions, cs, settlement)
    tenors = list(par.tenors)
    rows = []
    agg_cf_years: list[np.ndarray] = []
    agg_cf_amts: list[np.ndarray] = []
    for pr in priced:
        p = pr.pos
        scale = p.face_amount / 100.0
        yr = risk_at_yield(pr.cf, pr.ytm)
        cr = curve_risk(pr.cf, cs)
        mv = pr.dirty * scale
        rows.append(
            {
                "id": p.id,
                "label": p.label,
                "coupon_pct": p.coupon_rate * 100,
                "maturity": p.maturity.isoformat(),
                "years_to_maturity": _years(settlement, p.maturity),
                "face_amount": p.face_amount,
                "frequency": p.frequency,
                "day_count": p.day_count.value,
                "clean_price": pr.dirty - pr.cf.accrued,
                "dirty_price": pr.dirty,
                "accrued_per_100": pr.cf.accrued,
                "accrued_amount": pr.cf.accrued * scale,
                "market_value": mv,
                "ytm_pct": pr.ytm * 100,
                "macaulay_duration": yr.macaulay,
                "modified_duration": yr.modified,
                "effective_duration": cr.effective_duration,
                "convexity": yr.convexity,
                "effective_convexity": cr.effective_convexity,
                "dv01": cr.dv01 * scale,
                "krd": cr.krd,
                "kr_dv01": {t: v * scale for t, v in cr.kr_dv01.items()},
                "next_coupon": pr.cf.next_coupon.isoformat() if pr.cf.next_coupon else None,
            }
        )
        agg_cf_years.append(pr.cf.years)
        agg_cf_amts.append(pr.cf.amounts * scale)

    mv_total = sum(r["market_value"] for r in rows)
    if mv_total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("portfolio market value must be positive")
    dv01_total = sum(r["dv01"] for r in rows)
    for r in rows:
        r["weight"] = r["market_value"] / mv_total
        r["duration_contribution"] = r["weight"] * r["modified_duration"]
        r["dv01_share"] = r["dv01"] / dv01_total if dv01_total else 0.0

    w = np.array([r["weight"] for r in rows])
    mod_dur = float(sum(r["duration_contribution"] for r in rows))
    eff_dur = float(sum(r["weight"] * r["effective_duration"] for r in rows))
    convexity = float(sum(r["weight"] * r["convexity"] for r in rows))
    krd = {t: float(sum(r["weight"] * r["krd"][t] for r in rows)) for t in tenors}
    kr_dv01 = {t: float(sum(r["kr_dv01"][t] for r in rows)) for t in tenors}

    # Portfolio yield, two stated conventions.
    mv_weighted_ytm = float(np.dot(w, [r["ytm_pct"] for r in rows]))
    agg = CashFlows(
        settlement=settlement,
        dates=(),
        amounts=np.concatenate(agg_cf_amts),
        years=np.concatenate(agg_cf_years),
        compounding=2,
    )
    cash_flow_yield = yield_from_dirty_price(agg, mv_total) * 100

    buckets = []
    for name, lo, hi in MATURITY_BUCKETS:
        sel = [r for r in rows if lo <= r["years_to_maturity"] < hi]
        buckets.append(
            {
                "bucket": name,
                "market_value": sum(r["market_value"] for r in sel),
                "weight": sum(r["weight"] for r in sel),
                "dv01": sum(r["dv01"] for r in sel),
                "count": len(sel),
            }
        )

    hhi = float(np.sum(w**2))
    dv01_sh = np.array([r["dv01_share"] for r in rows])
    conc_warnings = []
    if w.max() > MAX_WEIGHT_WARN:
        top = rows[int(w.argmax())]["label"]
        conc_warnings.append(f"{top} is {w.max():.0%} of market value (> {MAX_WEIGHT_WARN:.0%} threshold).")
    if dv01_sh.max() > MAX_DV01_SHARE_WARN and len(rows) > 1:
        top = rows[int(dv01_sh.argmax())]["label"]
        conc_warnings.append(f"{top} contributes {dv01_sh.max():.0%} of portfolio DV01 (> {MAX_DV01_SHARE_WARN:.0%}).")

    return {
        "settlement": settlement.isoformat(),
        "curve_as_of": par.as_of,
        "summary": {
            "market_value": mv_total,
            "face_amount": sum(p.face_amount for p in positions),
            "accrued_interest": sum(r["accrued_amount"] for r in rows),
            "modified_duration": mod_dur,
            "effective_duration": eff_dur,
            "convexity": convexity,
            "dv01": dv01_total,
            "mv_weighted_ytm_pct": mv_weighted_ytm,
            "cash_flow_yield_pct": cash_flow_yield,
            "positions": len(rows),
            "weighted_avg_maturity": float(np.dot(w, [r["years_to_maturity"] for r in rows])),
        },
        "key_rate_durations": krd,
        "key_rate_dv01": kr_dv01,
        "holdings": rows,
        "maturity_buckets": buckets,
        "concentration": {
            "hhi": hhi,
            "effective_positions": 1.0 / hhi,
            "max_weight": float(w.max()),
            "top3_weight": float(np.sort(w)[::-1][:3].sum()),
            "max_dv01_share": float(dv01_sh.max()),
            "dv01_hhi": float(np.sum(dv01_sh**2)),
            "warnings": conc_warnings,
            "thresholds": {"max_weight": MAX_WEIGHT_WARN, "max_dv01_share": MAX_DV01_SHARE_WARN},
        },
        "conventions": {
            "duration": "Modified duration is w.r.t. each bond's own YTM (street convention); effective duration is w.r.t. a parallel +/-1bp par-curve shift.",
            "dv01": "Positive DV01 = dollar loss for a +1bp parallel par-curve shift (effective, full revaluation).",
            "portfolio_yield": "mv_weighted_ytm: market-value-weighted average YTM (an approximation). cash_flow_yield: IRR of aggregated cash flows vs. total dirty market value, semiannual bond-equivalent basis.",
            "weights": "Weights use dirty market value (price + accrued).",
        },
        "assumptions": VALUATION_ASSUMPTIONS,
        "curve_warnings": cs.base.warnings,
    }


@dataclass
class ScenarioResult:
    base: dict
    shocked: dict
    shocks_bp: dict[str, float]
    pnl: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    totals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def run_scenario(
    positions: list[Position], par: ParCurve, shocks_bp: dict[str, float], settlement: date
) -> dict:
    """Instantaneous scenario: full revaluation plus first/second-order approximations."""
    unknown = set(shocks_bp) - set(par.tenors)
    shocks = {t: float(shocks_bp.get(t, 0.0)) for t in par.tenors}
    shocked_par = par.shocked(shocks)
    cs_base = CurveSet.build(par)
    cs_shock = CurveSet.build(shocked_par)
    base = analyze_portfolio(positions, par, settlement, cs_base)
    after = analyze_portfolio(positions, shocked_par, settlement, cs_shock)
    zc_shock = bootstrap(shocked_par)

    pnl = []
    for b, a, pos in zip(base["holdings"], after["holdings"], positions):
        full = a["market_value"] - b["market_value"]
        # First order: key-rate DV01s x tenor shocks (dollar DV01 is per +1bp, loss-positive).
        krd_approx = -sum(b["kr_dv01"][t] * shocks[t] for t in par.tenors)
        # Effective yield change seen by the bond = KRD-weighted average of the tenor shocks.
        krd_sum = sum(b["krd"].values())
        dy_eff_bp = sum(b["krd"][t] * shocks[t] for t in par.tenors) / krd_sum if krd_sum else 0.0
        cvx_adj = 0.5 * b["effective_convexity"] * (dy_eff_bp * BP) ** 2 * b["market_value"]
        pnl.append(
            {
                "id": b["id"],
                "label": b["label"],
                "market_value_before": b["market_value"],
                "market_value_after": a["market_value"],
                "pnl_full": full,
                "return_full": full / b["market_value"],
                "pnl_krd_approx": krd_approx,
                "pnl_krd_convexity_approx": krd_approx + cvx_adj,
                "effective_yield_change_bp": dy_eff_bp,
                "ytm_change_bp": (a["ytm_pct"] - b["ytm_pct"]) * 100,
                "price_before": b["clean_price"],
                "price_after": a["clean_price"],
                "duration_before": b["modified_duration"],
                "duration_after": a["modified_duration"],
            }
        )
    total = sum(r["pnl_full"] for r in pnl)
    for r in pnl:
        r["share_of_pnl"] = r["pnl_full"] / total if abs(total) > 1e-9 else 0.0
    zero_t = np.array([0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 20, 30])
    return {
        "shocks_bp": shocks,
        "ignored_shock_tenors": sorted(unknown),
        "base_curve_pct": par.to_percent(),
        "shocked_curve_pct": shocked_par.to_percent(),
        "base_zero_pct": {f"{t:g}": float(v * 100) for t, v in zip(zero_t, cs_base.base.zero_rate(zero_t))},
        "shocked_zero_pct": {f"{t:g}": float(v * 100) for t, v in zip(zero_t, zc_shock.zero_rate(zero_t))},
        "base": base,
        "shocked": after,
        "pnl": pnl,
        "totals": {
            "pnl_full": total,
            "return_full": total / base["summary"]["market_value"],
            "pnl_krd_approx": sum(r["pnl_krd_approx"] for r in pnl),
            "pnl_krd_convexity_approx": sum(r["pnl_krd_convexity_approx"] for r in pnl),
            "duration_change": after["summary"]["modified_duration"] - base["summary"]["modified_duration"],

def _rounded_coupon(par_yield: float) -> float:
    """Round a par yield to the nearest 1/8 of a percent (Treasury coupon increment)."""
    return round(par_yield * 100 * 8) / 8 / 100


def _bond_at(settlement: date, years: int, par: ParCurve, face: float, label: str | None = None) -> Position:
    from app.core.schedule import add_months

    mat = add_months(settlement, 12 * years)
    zc = bootstrap(par)
    cpn = _rounded_coupon(zc.par_yield(years))
    return Position(
        id=f"UST-{years}Y",
        label=label or f"UST {cpn*100:.3f}% {mat:%b-%Y} ({years}Y)",
        coupon_rate=cpn,
        maturity=mat,
        face_amount=face,
    )


SAMPLE_PORTFOLIOS = {
    "short": "Short-duration Treasury",
    "intermediate": "Intermediate Treasury",
    "long": "Long-duration Treasury",
    "bullet": "Bullet (10Y)",
    "barbell": "Barbell (2Y / 30Y, duration-matched to bullet)",
    "ladder": "Laddered Treasury (1Y-10Y)",
}


def sample_portfolio(name: str, par: ParCurve, settlement: date, notional: float = 100_000_000) -> list[Position]:
    """Hypothetical Treasury-style portfolios. Coupons = curve par yield rounded to 1/8%.

    The bonds are *illustrative constructs* issued 'today' at each tenor, not
    actual CUSIPs; they trade near par by construction.
    """
    b = lambda y, f: _bond_at(settlement, y, par, f)  # noqa: E731
    if name == "short":
        return [b(1, 0.3 * notional), b(2, 0.4 * notional), b(3, 0.3 * notional)]
    if name == "intermediate":
        return [b(3, 0.2 * notional), b(5, 0.3 * notional), b(7, 0.3 * notional), b(10, 0.2 * notional)]
    if name == "long":
        return [b(10, 0.3 * notional), b(20, 0.3 * notional), b(30, 0.4 * notional)]
    if name == "bullet":
        return [b(10, notional)]
    if name == "ladder":
        return [b(y, notional / 10) for y in range(1, 11)]
    if name == "barbell":
        # Solve weights w2 + w30 = 1 so that MV-weighted modified duration equals the 10Y bullet.
        bullet = analyze_portfolio([b(10, notional)], par, settlement)
        d_target = bullet["summary"]["modified_duration"]
        trial = analyze_portfolio([b(2, notional), b(30, notional)], par, settlement)
        d2, d30 = (h["modified_duration"] for h in trial["holdings"])
        p2, p30 = (h["dirty_price"] for h in trial["holdings"])
        w30 = (d_target - d2) / (d30 - d2)
        w2 = 1 - w30
        mv = bullet["summary"]["market_value"]
        return [b(2, w2 * mv / p2 * 100), b(30, w30 * mv / p30 * 100)]
    raise KeyError(f"unknown sample portfolio {name!r}")

"""Curve-based valuation and risk: effective duration/convexity and key-rate durations.

Method (Ho, 1992 key-rate durations, applied to the *par* curve):
* Bump the par yield at one published tenor by +/-1bp, leaving the others
  unchanged. With linear par-yield interpolation the bump is a triangle that
  peaks at that tenor and fades to zero at the neighbouring tenors.
* Re-bootstrap the discount curve and fully reprice every cash flow.
* KRD_k = (P_down - P_up) / (2 * P_0 * 0.0001); KR-DV01_k = (P_down - P_up)/2.
Because the triangular bumps sum to a parallel shift, the KRDs sum (up to
second-order bootstrap effects) to the effective duration for a parallel
shift of the par curve -- this is asserted in the test-suite.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

from app.core.bond import CashFlows
from app.core.curve import ParCurve, ZeroCurve, bootstrap

BUMP_BP = 1.0


def price_on_curve(cf: CashFlows, zc: ZeroCurve) -> float:
    """Dirty price (per 100) discounting every cash flow on the zero curve."""
    return float(np.dot(cf.amounts, zc.discount(cf.years)))


@dataclass
class CurveSet:
    """Base curve plus the bumped curves needed for effective and key-rate risk."""

    par: ParCurve
    base: ZeroCurve
    up: ZeroCurve
    down: ZeroCurve
    key_up: dict[str, ZeroCurve]
    key_down: dict[str, ZeroCurve]
    bump_bp: float = BUMP_BP

    @classmethod
    def build(cls, par: ParCurve, bump_bp: float = BUMP_BP) -> "CurveSet":
        allbp = {t: bump_bp for t in par.tenors}
        allbm = {t: -bump_bp for t in par.tenors}
        key_up = {t: bootstrap(par.shocked({t: bump_bp})) for t in par.tenors}
        key_down = {t: bootstrap(par.shocked({t: -bump_bp})) for t in par.tenors}
        return cls(
            par=par,
            base=bootstrap(par),
            up=bootstrap(par.shocked(allbp)),
            down=bootstrap(par.shocked(allbm)),
            key_up=key_up,
            key_down=key_down,
            bump_bp=bump_bp,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurveRisk:
    dirty: float
    effective_duration: float
    effective_convexity: float
    dv01: float  # per 100 face, effective (parallel par-curve shift)
    krd: dict[str, float]  # key-rate durations (years)
    kr_dv01: dict[str, float]  # per 100 face


def curve_risk(cf: CashFlows, cs: CurveSet) -> CurveRisk:
    p0 = price_on_curve(cf, cs.base)
    pu = price_on_curve(cf, cs.up)
    pd = price_on_curve(cf, cs.down)
    h = cs.bump_bp * 1e-4
    eff_dur = (pd - pu) / (2 * p0 * h)
    eff_cvx = (pd + pu - 2 * p0) / (p0 * h * h)
    krd, krdv = {}, {}
    for t in cs.par.tenors:
        a = price_on_curve(cf, cs.key_down[t])
        b = price_on_curve(cf, cs.key_up[t])
        krd[t] = (a - b) / (2 * p0 * h)
        krdv[t] = (a - b) / 2 / cs.bump_bp
    return CurveRisk(p0, eff_dur, eff_cvx, (pd - pu) / 2 / cs.bump_bp, krd, krdv)

"""Coupon schedule generation.

Schedules are generated *backward from maturity* in steps of 12/frequency
months, which is how U.S. Treasury notes/bonds are scheduled (coupons fall on
the maturity day-of-month). If the maturity date is the last day of its month,
every coupon date is a month-end (end-of-month rule).

Assumption: the schedule is regular -- odd (short/long) first coupons are not
modeled. For seasoned bonds this only affects cash flows before settlement,
which are irrelevant to valuation; the *quasi-coupon* date on or before
settlement is used to compute accrued interest.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta


def is_month_end(d: date) -> bool:
    return d.day == calendar.monthrange(d.year, d.month)[1]


def add_months(d: date, months: int, eom: bool = False) -> date:
    y, m = divmod(d.month - 1 + months, 12)
    year, month = d.year + y, m + 1
    last = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    day = last if eom else min(d.day, last)
    return date(year, month, day)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CouponPeriod:
    """The coupon period containing settlement and all remaining payment dates."""

    previous_coupon: date  # quasi-coupon date on or before settlement
    next_coupon: date
    payment_dates: tuple[date, ...]  # strictly after settlement, ascending, ends at maturity


def coupon_schedule(settlement: date, maturity: date, frequency: int) -> CouponPeriod:
    """Return remaining coupon dates after ``settlement`` and the surrounding period.

    A coupon falling exactly on the settlement date belongs to the seller and is
    excluded (accrued interest is then zero).
    """
    if frequency not in (1, 2, 4, 12):
        raise ValueError("frequency must be one of 1, 2, 4, 12")
    if maturity <= settlement:
        raise ValueError("maturity must be after settlement")
    step = 12 // frequency
    eom = is_month_end(maturity)
    dates: list[date] = []
    k = 0
    while True:
        d = add_months(maturity, -step * k, eom=eom)
        if d <= settlement:
            previous = d
            break
        dates.append(d)
        k += 1
        if k > 12 * 200:  # pragma: no cover - guard
            raise RuntimeError("schedule generation runaway")
    dates.reverse()
    return CouponPeriod(previous_coupon=previous, next_coupon=dates[0], payment_dates=tuple(dates))


def add_business_days(d: date, n: int) -> date:
    """Add ``n`` weekdays (U.S. federal holidays are not modeled -- documented assumption)."""
    out = d
    while n > 0:
        out += timedelta(days=1)
        if out.weekday() < 5:
            n -= 1
    return out


def treasury_settlement(trade_date: date) -> date:
    """Regular settlement for U.S. Treasuries is T+1 business day."""
    return add_business_days(trade_date, 1)

* U.S. Department of the Treasury, "Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates"
  https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve
  Yields are par yields on a bond-equivalent (semiannual) basis, in percent,
  derived by Treasury from indicative bid-side prices of on-the-run securities.
* Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED. https://fred.stlouisfed.org
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
from datetime import date

import httpx
import pandas as pd

from app.config import settings

TREASURY_CSV_URL = (
    "https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/"
    "daily-treasury-rates.csv/{year}/all?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve"
    "&field_tdr_date_value={year}&page&_format=csv"
)
TREASURY_SOURCE_PAGE = (
    "https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/"
    "TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve"

FRED_GRAPH_CSV_URL = "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id={series_id}"
FRED_API_URL = "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"
FRED_SERIES_PAGE = "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{series_id}"

# Canonical tenor labels used throughout the application, with year fractions.
TENORS: list[str] = ["1M", "3M", "6M", "1Y", "2Y", "3Y", "5Y", "7Y", "10Y", "20Y", "30Y"]
TENOR_YEARS: dict[str, float] = {
    "1M": 1 / 12, "3M": 0.25, "6M": 0.5, "1Y": 1.0, "2Y": 2.0, "3Y": 3.0,
    "5Y": 5.0, "7Y": 7.0, "10Y": 10.0, "20Y": 20.0, "30Y": 30.0,
}

# Treasury CSV column header -> canonical tenor. Columns not listed (2M, 4M,
# 1.5M) are published but intentionally not used so that the tenor set is
# stable across the full history.
_TREASURY_COLUMN_MAP = {
    "1 Mo": "1M", "3 Mo": "3M", "6 Mo": "6M", "1 Yr": "1Y", "2 Yr": "2Y", "3 Yr": "3Y",
    "5 Yr": "5Y", "7 Yr": "7Y", "10 Yr": "10Y", "20 Yr": "20Y", "30 Yr": "30Y",
}

# a secondary source if Treasury's site is unavailable).
FRED_CMT_SERIES = {
    "1M": "DGS1MO", "3M": "DGS3MO", "6M": "DGS6MO", "1Y": "DGS1", "2Y": "DGS2", "3Y": "DGS3",

FRED_SERIES_META: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {

class DataSourceError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when an external source cannot be reached or returns invalid data."""


def _client() -> httpx.Client:
    return httpx.Client(
        timeout=settings.http_timeout,
        headers={"User-Agent": "monetary-research-terminal/1.0 (open-source research tool)"},
        follow_redirects=True,
    )


def parse_treasury_csv(text: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Parse one Treasury par-yield CSV into a DataFrame indexed by date.

    Values are percent (e.g. 4.25 = 4.25%). Tenors absent for the period
    (e.g. 20Y before 1993-10, 30Y between 2002-02 and 2006-02, 1M before
    2001-07) are left as NaN -- they are never filled.
    """
    raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text))
    if "Date" not in raw.columns:
        raise DataSourceError("Treasury CSV missing 'Date' column")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.to_datetime(raw["Date"], format="%m/%d/%Y"))
    out.index.name = "date"
    for col, tenor in _TREASURY_COLUMN_MAP.items():
        out[tenor] = pd.to_numeric(raw[col], errors="coerce").to_numpy() if col in raw.columns else float("nan")
    out = out[TENORS].sort_index()
    out = out[~out.index.duplicated(keep="last")]
    _validate_yields(out)
    return out


def _validate_yields(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    vals = df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    finite = vals[~pd.isna(vals)]
    if finite.size and (finite.min() < -5 or finite.max() > 30):
        raise DataSourceError("Treasury yields outside plausible range [-5%, 30%] - refusing to ingest")


def fetch_treasury_year(year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    url = TREASURY_CSV_URL.format(year=year)
    try:
        with _client() as c:
            r = c.get(url)
            r.raise_for_status()
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - network
        raise DataSourceError(f"Treasury request failed for {year}: {exc}") from exc
    if not r.text.strip() or "Date" not in r.text[:200]:
        raise DataSourceError(f"Treasury returned no CSV data for {year}")
    return parse_treasury_csv(r.text)


def fetch_treasury_range(start_year: int, end_year: int | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    end_year = end_year or date.today().year
    frames = [fetch_treasury_year(y) for y in range(start_year, end_year + 1)]
    df = pd.concat(frames).sort_index()
    return df[~df.index.duplicated(keep="last")]


def parse_fred_csv(text: str, series_id: str) -> pd.Series:
    raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text))
    date_col = "observation_date" if "observation_date" in raw.columns else raw.columns[0]
    if series_id not in raw.columns:
        raise DataSourceError(f"FRED CSV for {series_id} missing value column")
    s = pd.Series(
        pd.to_numeric(raw[series_id], errors="coerce").to_numpy(),
        index=pd.to_datetime(raw[date_col]),
        name=series_id,
    )
    s.index.name = "date"
    return s.dropna().sort_index()


def fetch_fred_series(series_id: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Fetch a full FRED series. Missing observations ('.') are dropped, never filled."""
    try:
        with _client() as c:
            if settings.fred_api_key:
                r = c.get(
                    FRED_API_URL,
                    params={"series_id": series_id, "api_key": settings.fred_api_key, "file_type": "json"},
                )
                r.raise_for_status()
                obs = r.json()["observations"]
                s = pd.Series(
                    pd.to_numeric([o["value"] for o in obs], errors="coerce"),
                    index=pd.to_datetime([o["date"] for o in obs]),
                    name=series_id,
                )
                s.index.name = "date"
                return s.dropna().sort_index()
            r = c.get(FRED_GRAPH_CSV_URL.format(series_id=series_id))
            r.raise_for_status()
    except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # pragma: no cover - network
        raise DataSourceError(f"FRED request failed for {series_id}: {exc}") from exc
    return parse_fred_csv(r.text, series_id)
